household.notes: Real spend runs ~700-800 because leftovers carry days. Model pantry carryover or the plan over-shops.

preferences.text: Wholegrain toast + avocado + poached egg on weekday breakfasts
No rice at lunch; re-serve leftovers as salads, bowls or wraps
Rice and roti are fine at dinner
Keep the leftover-into-lunch structure (saves cost and waste)
~60/40 non-veg to veg, counting fish and eggs as non-veg
Feature mushrooms through the week; include a mushroom risotto dinner
Cold leftover salad bowls lose appeal by midweek; offer wraps as a fallback
Avocado is perishable and price-variable in Danish supermarkets
Watch cholesterol if risotto and a roast land in the same week
